messages:
amelia_cs: URGENT: HorizonPark usage down ~91% after their IdP-X cutover at ~02:25 UTC. Nightly model runs stopped. They opened HP-824 and procurement is already asking for a timeline. Mentioned they have a parallel competitive trial.
diego_csm: Thanks. I tried contacting their new ML lead (carlos) and procurement lead (marie) but no answer yet. Ticket says 401s then occasional 502s. They want a remediation ETA within 72h.
sophie_solutions: I offered immediate sandbox creds and a short troubleshooting session. Customer asked for a simple SSO failure checklist and an exec-to-exec note proving we can contain risk. I'll draft both.
rahul_eng: From traces: auth-exchange failures -> kvcache cold -> routing fallback. Burst window 02:23-02:30 UTC. If they paste one full request/response we can reproduce. Technical example to share with them:
```
REQUEST 2025-04-11T02:26:12Z -> 401 Unauthorized
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Trace: auth-exchange-failed -> kvcache-miss -> routing-fallback -> 502
```
amelia_cs: Customer message (HP-824): "After migrating IdP, our inference pipeline returns 401 or times out to 502. We're running a competitor PoC this week and need assurance we'll be back in production quickly."
diego_csm: Risk: procurement may fast-track the competitor if we can't produce a short containment plan. Suggestion from sales: offer 7 days of reserved burst credits + priority eng remediation (timeboxed) and an exec call. No long-term discount. Any technical blockers?
rahul_eng: We can stand up an auth-shim (proxy) that translates their token exchange patterns and a temporary sandbox key. ETA 3-6h after their approval. We can also provide a rollback guide to switch back to legacy auth if needed. We need a sample failing request ASAP.
sophie_solutions: I'll request the raw request/response and send the SSO checklist. Draft checklist items: 1) paste failing request/response, 2) confirm token TTL/clock skew, 3) try rotating service token, 4) run smoke job with sandbox creds, 5) enable auth-shim if failures persist.
amelia_cs: Plan of record: 1) Sophie to request raw request+response from HorizonPark. 2) Rahul to prep auth-shim and sandbox key standby. 3) Diego to coordinate commercial guardrail (7-day reserved credits + priority eng) with sales. 4) Amelia to schedule an exec-to-exec 20-min call and a 30-min technical troubleshooting session with the ML lead.
hp-support-bot: Ticket HP-824 comment added by amelia_cs at 2025-04-11T09:45Z
diego_csm: I'll also prepare an acceptance acknowledgement for HorizonPark to sign (mitigation scope + timebox) so we don't slip into an open-ended concession.
amelia_cs: I'll post calendar invite when times confirmed. Keep updates here — customer contact is carlos@horizonpark (ML lead) and marie.procurement@horizonpark. :thumbsup:
